description: Nested full splats give a tuple of tuples
notes: The spec's grammar lets a full splat consume only attribute accesses and index operations (fullSplat = "[" "*" "]" (GetAttr | Index)*), so a second splat operator would start a new splat on the first splat's whole result, and the prose doesn't mention nesting. hashicorp/hcl makes everything after [*], including further splats, part of the first splat's each expression (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go). Read that way, the second splat would apply .c to each tuple of b values, which is an error.
